description: The range a player takes one flop action with, from a solved pack: hand-class weights ("AA:1,AKs:0.42,...", same format as the preflop ranges) after every earlier flop action on the path. `path` ends in the action whose range you want, e.g. ["Check", "Bet 1.8", "Call 1.8"] for the check-call range. Bet-size tree. "33" = 33% pot on the flop, then 75% pot on the turn and river, plus all-in. "75" = 75% pot on every street, plus all-in. Compact and full detail apply to the other range tools; this returns the action range itself.

hand.description: Optional exact combo (AsKh) or hand class (AKs) for one frequency instead of reading the whole range.

minFreq.description: Drop classes at or below this weight. Default 0.

path.description: Flop actions ending in the action whose range you want

tree.description: Bet-size tree. "33" = 33% pot on the flop, then 75% pot on the turn and river, plus all-in. "75" = 75% pot on every street, plus all-in. PLO5 packs are solved on "33" only.

name: get_postflop_range

outputSchema.description: The range a player takes one flop action with, as hand-class weights.

action.description: The action whose range this is.

board.description: Canonical board as stored in the pack.

error.description: Present instead of a payload when the request named something that does not exist. No figure is estimated in its place.

hand.description: The requested hand, when one was asked for.
Hand or class the frequency belongs to.

pack.description: Pack id the range was read from, after tree resolution.

path.description: Flop actions, ending in the action asked for.

range.description: Hand-class weights as "AA:1,AKs:0.42,…", the preflop range format.

summary.description: What the compact range left out, so nothing looks complete when it is sampled.

classes.description: Postflop: hand classes with reach at the node.

matchingHands.description: plo5: classes that take the action before the cut.

mixedInReturned.description: plo5: mixed classes among the returned rows.

nonzeroHands.description: Hand classes with a frequency above 0.

omitted.description: Rows dropped by the compact cut.

pureInReturned.description: plo5: pure classes among the returned rows.

weights.description: Hand class to frequency. An omitted class has weight 0.

title: Get postflop action range
